effect.name: GM Optical Diffusion
effect.desc: Fine highlight diffusion that retains low-frequency contrast.
effect.shader: const vec3 L=vec3(0.2126,0.7152,0.0722);void main(){vec2 uv=acScreenNorm;vec2 texSize=max(inputImg.size,vec2(1.0));vec2 p=radius/texSize;vec4 s=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,uv);vec3 b=s.rgb*0.25;b+=(texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(uv+p,0.0,1.0)).rgb+texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(uv-p,0.0,1.0)).rgb+texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(uv+vec2(p.x,-p.y),0.0,1.0)).rgb+texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(uv+vec2(-p.x,p.y),0.0,1.0)).rgb)*0.1875;float y=dot(s.rgb,L);float m=clamp(mixAmount,0.0,1.0)*mix(1.0,smoothstep(0.15,1.0,y),clamp(highlightBias,0.0,1.0));gl_FragColor=vec4(mix(s.rgb,b,clamp(m,0.0,1.0)),s.a);}
